long_biography.plain_text:
In 2012, Sozialwerk Heuser bought the insolvent Ghersburg nursing home in Bad Aibling for a multimillion-euro sum and kept it operating. Johannes Heuser and his mother Irene then began planning renovations and assisted living, continuing the care philosophy established by his father, Erich-Gottfried Heuser.

Heuser now owns and manages a group active in senior residences, outpatient care, supported living and services for children, young people and people with disabilities. Its operations span Bavaria, Thuringia and North Rhine-Westphalia. The organisation's distinctive care model also uses art and environmental therapies, an approach developed through Irene Heuser's work.

Its operations span Bavaria, Thuringia and North Rhine-Westphalia.
